notes:
Lead profile: small ecommerce platform (order/ticketing + KB) — wants self-serve hosted API. Primary contact: CTO (Maya Chen) + eng lead. Key quote from CTO: "We need graceful degradation during marketing blasts — 429s kill the UX."

Main requirements / concerns (shorthand):
- Workload: support chat + semantic search for returns routing, occasional reranking for product suggestions.
- Targets: p95 latency target ~<600ms for single-turn replies; throughput spikes up to ~100-150 req/s during promos. Cost-sensitive — wants predictable per-token billing and clear quota thresholds.
- Rate limiting pain: saw 429s in earlier test at ~95 concurrent requests; current starter tier concurrency cap unclear. CTO: "Can we burst when needed and not lose in-flight requests?"
- Desired features: per-key quotas, burst window, soft 429 signals (Retry-After headers), explanatory rate-limit headers, automatic sandbox quota bumps for validated accounts, documentation with backoff recipes and SDK retries.
- Security: SMB but wants SOC2 attestation before committing to monthly billing; audit logs and basic retention controls requested. Public cloud deployment only (no VPC/on-prem).

Eng notes / AE shorthand:
- Customer arrived via docs -> got free credits -> tested SDK. Integration simple.
- SE recommended: client-side exponential backoff, jitter, idempotency tokens for retries; server-side: suggest using Redwood's burst buffer / temporary higher concurrency for short windows (ask infra team for temporary uplift).
- Action items: 1) upload rate-limit best practices + sample retry middleware (done), 2) SE workshop to run controlled spike (provisioned for w/c 2026-03-17), 3) legal sent SOC2 summary deck; follow up on 03/15.

POC notes: 2-week pilot proposed (low ARR, but high potential to convert to Dedicated if traffic grows). Blocker: billing sign-off and SOC2 comfort. If we can demonstrate smooth burst handling and visible Retry-After headers, CTO likely to convert to paid tier.
